tools.name: profitroot_get_ladder
tools.description: The margin ladder for the reconciled period: twelve rungs as Figures (value, grade, precision, basis, residual, gatedReason, asOf, source, disclosure) with the identity residual. A gated rung has value null.

tools.name: profitroot_get_reconciliation
tools.description: Net Sales reconciled to source: mapped total, source total, residual, coverage, excluded orders by reason with amounts, the guards' outcomes.

tools.name: profitroot_get_sources
tools.description: Source readiness: each source's status, reason, what it unlocks, and its freshness (current / delayed / missing / unmeasured). Covers the store's synced orders only: a source the merchant added elsewhere reads as needs_source here.

tools.name: profitroot_get_brief
tools.description: The latest persisted Daily Brief: findings with their evidence class, basis and rows; quiet flag; staleness. Findings only, never a proposal.
